LanguageData.SFRL_EnabledTip: Disabling this releases all inventory restrictions immediately.
LanguageData.SFRL_ControlSowingTip: Pause above the upper limit; resume below the lower limit. Already growing crops continue growing.
LanguageData.SFRL_ControlHarvestTip: Uses the same per-crop/product thresholds and hysteresis state as sowing. Also blocks designated and already assigned harvest jobs inside growing zones and player growing facilities. Cutting commands and wild plants outside these areas are unaffected. Unharvested crops still age and can die. Disabled by default.
LanguageData.SFRL_Explanation: Read vanilla stock counts every 600 ticks. Each product pauses above its upper limit and clears below its lower limit. Any non-ignored product still paused keeps the crop paused. New products are ignored.
LanguageData.SFRL_Compatibility: Smart Farming: {0} | High Density Hydroponics adapter: {1}
LanguageData.SFRL_NoProduct: No known harvested product yet; link one with +.
LanguageData.SFRL_Uncounted: Product is not counted by vanilla; not controlled.
LanguageData.SFRL_IndependentRule: Each crop/product pair has independent thresholds and hysteresis. Any non-ignored product still paused keeps the crop paused. Crops sharing a product do not overwrite each other. Counts are item units; threshold changes apply at the next 600-tick check.
LanguageData.SFRL_PausedBoth: {0}: sowing and harvesting paused by inventory limit.
LanguageData.SFRL_HideHarvestIconTip: Only hides the paused harvesting icon on the map.
LanguageData.SFRL_HideSowingIconTip: Only hides the paused sowing icon on the map.
LanguageData.SFRL_AddProduct: Manually link an additional harvested product. New links are ignored by default. Standard products are detected automatically; products using the standard additional-yield interface are detected on their first actual harvest.
LanguageData.SFRL_RemoveManualProduct: Delete this manual link and its thresholds. Only manually created links can be deleted. Automatically detected links and older links with unknown origin are protected.
